title: [Lean] Add conditional current1094 private-centre hosting adapter
body:
## Scope

Adds the exact checked `Current1094PrivateCentreHosting` adapter and reproducible source preparation for its two pinned prerequisites. The three conditional facts combine 704 supplied live owners with eight tagged private-centre owners and transport the supplied realization through its family projection.

Source-matched conditional context: κ = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918, from selected-result10b9e340/certificate1122cb3a, unchanged at applicability pin0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea. This package proves three conditional hosting facts for Fin704⊕Fin8 using supplied liveOwner injection, family projection and actual=realizeRun; it does not certify the full selected construction or multiplication exponent.

## Checked evidence and reproducibility

The coherent three-source chain was checked with Lean 4.21.0 and Mathlib commit `308445d7985027f538e281e18df29ca16ede2ba3`: three complete objects, three standard-only axiom probes and two full premise-type audits, with 6.875752744 seconds of compiler time. Independent acceptance is `766f77bb6ed4c0ef213ebe730294f92e90276b58f7033dc3e02e703f658b2e68`. The package retains the original parser failure and its read-only reconciliation.

`prepare_sources.py` materializes the exact public PR509 Stream and PR516 Realize dependencies at immutable commits; Realize receives one declared import-line substitution. Hashes, commands, attribution and complete scope are in the package README and manifests. A dedicated path-scoped GitHub Actions job replays this exact chain with pinned Lean/Mathlib and read-only permissions. That new job has not been run on this candidate before submission; CI will be checked after the PR is created.

## Attribution and limits

The new adapter and packaging were prepared with OpenAI assistance. Stream and Realize are attributed to DreamingOfClouds with Claude Opus 5.5 via Claude Code; their full original notices and Apache-2.0 license are included. No novelty is claimed for those prerequisites.

The supplied live-owner injection, family projection, and complete `actual = realizeRun` premise remain explicit. This chunk supplies no selected executor, concrete owner-table certificate, storage-precision bound, all-size cost theorem or full integer-multiplication construction. Its local native acceptance does not imply an upstream CI pass.
